items.title: MHRA approves J&J's once-daily oral psoriasis pill Icotyde
items.summary: The Medicines and Healthcare products Regulatory Agency (MHRA) has approved icotrokinra hydrochloride (Icotyde) for moderate to severe plaque psoriasis in adults and adolescents aged 12 and over weighing at least 40kg, authorisation granted to Janssen-Cilag Limited (Johnson & Johnson) on 23…
